guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: ESO Very Large Telescope
guides.concept: 以 Paranal 山頂四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡為對象，從視寧度與繞射的差距出發，拆解 Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與多焦點、177 mm 薄 Zerodur 主鏡製作、1170 致動器可變形副鏡、四雷射導引星、VLTI 延遲線與 ESPRESSO 的 10 cm/s 量測，最後整合成多望遠鏡的營運交接。
guides.conceptEn: Taking the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes on Cerro Paranal, start from the gap between seeing and diffraction and work through the Ritchey–Chrétien train and its foci, the 177 mm thin Zerodur primary, the 1170-actuator deformable secondary, four laser guide stars, VLTI delay lines and ESPRESSO's 10 cm/s measurement, ending in a multi-telescope operational handoff.
procedure: VLT 由四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡、四座可移動的 1.8 m 輔助望遠鏡與地下干涉實驗室組成，涵蓋近紫外到 25 µm。口徑帶來兩種好處：集光面積讓暗弱天體在有限時間內達到訊雜比，角解析度則理論上隨 λ/D 變好；但大氣湍流把波前切成尺寸約 Fried 參數 r₀ 的同調區塊，未修正時影像寬度由 λ/r₀ 決定，與口徑無關。因此 VLT 的工程設計一直沿著兩條線前進：把四座望遠鏡的光合在一起增加集光或基線，以及以主動與自適應光學把影像拉回繞射極限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每座 UT 為 Ritchey–Chrétien 設計：f/1.8 的薄主鏡與剛性輕量化的凸雙曲面副鏡共同消除球差與彗差，經地平式機架指向全天。光可以送到主鏡下方的 Cassegrain 焦點、兩側的 Nasmyth 焦點，或再經轉折送到地下的 coudé 焦點，讓大型穩定儀器固定不動。副鏡單元以五個自由度定位：一軸對焦、兩軸置中、兩軸指向；因為副鏡把主鏡焦比放大約 8 倍，副鏡的微小軸向位移會在焦面被放大，所以副鏡對焦是主動光學閉環中最頻繁的修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

UT 主鏡是直徑 8.2 m、厚約 177 mm 的 Zerodur 彎月鏡，成品重約 23 t；每片由 SCHOTT 澆鑄約 45 t 的玻璃陶瓷，經約 3 個月退火與 9 個月陶瓷化，膨脹係數規格 0 ± 0.15×10⁻⁶/K，交貨量測約 −0.03 到 −0.04×10⁻⁶/K。REOSC 在模擬最終鏡室的 150 點氣動支撐上研磨拋光，因為薄鏡本身不保形，驗收必須在主動模式下進行：允許致動器以有限的力修正低階面形，交付的波前約 40 nm RMS。薄鏡的另一個好處是熱慣量小，能跟上夜間氣溫，減少鏡面視寧度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

UT4 的自適應光學設施把原本的剛性副鏡換成直徑 1120 mm、厚約 2 mm 的 Zerodur 薄殼可變形副鏡，背後以 1170 個音圈致動器推動；薄殼由 SAGEM 製作，參考體由 SESO 以輕量化 Zerodur 製造，系統由 Microgate 與 ADS International 整合。每個致動器旁有電容感測器量測薄殼與參考體的約 90 µm 間隙，內迴路以 80 kHz 維持形狀，這層空氣膜同時提供阻尼。把自適應元件放在副鏡，讓所有焦點共用修正且不增加額外反射面與熱背景。致動器與電子機箱的熱必須以液冷帶走，否則副鏡附近形成局部湍流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1170 致動器可變形副鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

自然亮星很少落在目標附近，因此 UT4 以四雷射導引星設施在約 90 km 高的鈉層激發四顆人造星。四顆導引星環繞視場，GRAAL 模組把地表層湍流修正後的影像送給 HAWK-I，GALACSI 則為 MUSE 做地表層或雷射斷層修正。雷射星位於有限高度，光錐只取樣部分湍流（錐效應），且鈉層有約 10 km 厚度，從望遠鏡不同位置看到的雷射光點會被拉長，次孔徑離發射點越遠拉得越長。雷射星也無法量測整體傾斜，所以仍需要一顆暗的自然星提供傾斜資訊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四雷射導引星設施」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

VLTI 把兩到四座望遠鏡的光經地下光管送到延遲線，延遲線是放在長軌道上的貓眼反射車，隨地球自轉連續移動以補償幾何光程差，使各路光在合光器處等光程而產生干涉條紋。UT 間基線可達約 130 m，輔助望遠鏡可移到不同基座組成約 200 m 的基線。條紋對比（可見度）攜帶目標的空間頻率資訊，但只要各路光程差抖動接近波長的十分之一，可見度就明顯下降；GRAVITY 等儀器以條紋追蹤器在 K 波段即時量測並回授到延遲線，再以雷射計量量測內部光程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「VLTI 延遲線隧道」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

ESPRESSO 位於合併 coudé 實驗室，可經 coudé 光路收單一 UT 的光，或同時收四座 UT 的光（非同調合併），以換取更暗目標的訊雜比。它的目標是在十年尺度上達到 10 cm/s 的徑向速度精度，解析度依模式約 70,000、140,000 或 190,000。要量到如此小的都卜勒位移，光譜儀必須放在真空、毫開爾文級溫控的環境中，以光纖與散射器穩定照明，並以頻率梳或 Fabry–Pérot 標準具同時記錄波長參考；望遠鏡端的導星與大氣色散補償則決定光纖入口的照明穩定性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ESPRESSO 與合併 coudé 實驗室」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

四座 UT 各有不同焦點的常駐儀器，營運上要協調哪座望遠鏡做 VLTI、哪座做自適應光學、哪座提供 coudé 光，維護計畫也必須錯開。主鏡單元約 50 t，需從望遠鏡卸下送到山上的鍍膜廠清洗並重鍍鋁膜；灰塵沉積會逐步降低反射率並增加熱輻射背景，對中紅外儀器尤其不利。交接紀錄要包含每座望遠鏡的影像品質、主動光學力圖、自適應光學性能、延遲線狀態與反射率歷史，才能讓下一個觀測期的排程以實際能力為準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主鏡單元維護與鍍膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The VLT comprises four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes, four relocatable 1.8 m Auxiliary Telescopes and an underground interferometric laboratory, covering the near ultraviolet to 25 µm. Aperture brings two benefits: collecting area lets faint targets reach a useful signal-to-noise ratio in finite time, and angular resolution in principle improves as λ/D. Atmospheric turbulence, however, breaks the wavefront into coherent patches of about the Fried parameter r₀, so the uncorrected image width is set by λ/r₀ regardless of aperture. VLT engineering has therefore advanced along two lines: combining the four telescopes for more collecting area or longer baselines, and using active and adaptive optics to pull images back toward the diffraction limit. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each UT is a Ritchey–Chrétien design: an f/1.8 thin primary and a rigid, lightweight convex hyperboloidal secondary jointly cancel spherical aberration and coma, pointed over the whole sky by an alt-azimuth mount. Light can go to the Cassegrain focus below the primary, to the two Nasmyth foci at the sides, or be relayed to a coudé focus in the basement so that large, stable instruments stay fixed. The secondary unit is positioned in five degrees of freedom: one for focus, two for centring and two for pointing. Because the secondary magnifies the primary focal ratio about eightfold, small axial secondary motions are amplified at the focal plane, which makes secondary focus the most frequent correction in the active-optics loop. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each UT primary is a Zerodur meniscus 8.2 m across and about 177 mm thick, weighing about 23 t finished; SCHOTT cast about 45 t of glass ceramic per blank, followed by roughly 3 months of annealing and 9 months of ceramisation, to a thermal-expansion specification of 0 ± 0.15×10⁻⁶/K, with delivered blanks measuring about −0.03 to −0.04×10⁻⁶/K. REOSC ground and polished on a 150-point pneumatic support that mimics the final cell; because a thin mirror cannot hold its own shape, acceptance is done in active mode, letting actuators correct low-order figure with limited forces, and delivered wavefronts were about 40 nm RMS. The thin mirror's low thermal inertia also lets it follow the night-time air temperature, reducing mirror seeing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The UT4 Adaptive Optics Facility replaced the rigid secondary with a deformable secondary: a Zerodur shell 1120 mm across and about 2 mm thick, pushed by 1170 voice-coil actuators. SAGEM produced the shell, SESO the lightweighted Zerodur reference body, and Microgate with ADS International integrated the system. A capacitive sensor beside each actuator measures the roughly 90 µm gap between shell and reference body, an internal loop at 80 kHz holds the shape, and the air film provides damping. Putting the adaptive element at the secondary lets all foci share the correction without extra reflections or thermal background. Heat from actuators and electronics must be carried away by liquid cooling, or local turbulence forms around the secondary. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1170-actuator deformable secondary”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Bright natural stars rarely lie near a target, so UT4 uses the Four Laser Guide Star Facility to excite four artificial stars in the sodium layer at about 90 km. The four guide stars surround the field; the GRAAL module feeds ground-layer-corrected images to HAWK-I, and GALACSI provides ground-layer or laser-tomography correction for MUSE. Because a laser star sits at finite altitude, its light cone samples only part of the turbulence (the cone effect), and because the sodium layer is about 10 km thick, the spot seen from different parts of the pupil is elongated, more so for subapertures farther from the launch point. Laser stars also cannot measure overall tilt, so a faint natural star is still needed for tip-tilt. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four Laser Guide Star Facility”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

VLTI sends light from two to four telescopes through underground light ducts to the delay lines, cat's-eye carriages on long rails that move continuously with Earth rotation to cancel the geometric path difference so that all beams arrive at the combiner with equal path and form fringes. Baselines between UTs reach about 130 m, and the Auxiliary Telescopes can be moved between stations to form baselines of about 200 m. Fringe contrast (visibility) carries the target's spatial-frequency information, but once the path-difference jitter approaches a tenth of the wavelength the visibility drops markedly; instruments such as GRAVITY measure fringes in K band with a fringe tracker that feeds back to the delay lines, and laser metrology measures internal paths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “VLTI delay-line tunnel”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

ESPRESSO sits in the combined coudé laboratory and receives light from one UT through its coudé train, or from all four UTs at once (incoherent combination) to gain signal-to-noise on fainter targets. Its goal is 10 cm/s radial-velocity precision over a decade, with resolving power of about 70,000, 140,000 or 190,000 depending on mode. Measuring such tiny Doppler shifts requires the spectrograph to sit in vacuum with millikelvin-class temperature control, fibre feeds with scramblers to stabilise illumination, and a frequency comb or Fabry–Pérot etalon recorded simultaneously as wavelength reference; guiding and atmospheric-dispersion correction at the telescope set how stable the fibre entrance illumination is. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ESPRESSO and the combined coudé laboratory”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The four UTs carry resident instruments at different foci, so operations must coordinate which telescope serves VLTI, which runs adaptive optics and which feeds the coudé laboratory, and maintenance must be staggered. The roughly 50 t primary-mirror unit is removed from the telescope and taken to the on-site coating plant for cleaning and aluminium recoating; dust gradually lowers reflectance and raises thermal background, which hurts mid-infrared instruments in particular. The handoff record must include each telescope's image quality, active-optics force maps, AO performance, delay-line status and reflectance history so that the next period's schedule rests on actual capability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Primary-mirror unit maintenance and coating”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若只看口徑而忽略站址與局部湍流，8 m 級望遠鏡的影像會和 1 m 級望遠鏡一樣寬，只多了集光；更常見的是把圓頂內熱湍流誤當成大氣視寧度，導致錯誤地升級光學而非改善熱控。
鈉層高度在夜間變化數公里時，雷射星的對焦也跟著改變；若沒有以自然星的慢速對焦感測修正，系統會把鈉層高度變化誤當成望遠鏡離焦，科學影像持續失焦。
pitfallsEn: Judging a telescope by aperture alone, without site and local turbulence, leaves an 8 m class telescope with images as wide as a 1 m telescope and only more light; more commonly, dome thermal turbulence is mistaken for atmospheric seeing and the optics are upgraded instead of the thermal control.

When the sodium-layer altitude changes by kilometres during the night, the laser-star focus changes with it; without slow natural-star focus sensing, the system interprets sodium-height changes as telescope defocus and the science image stays out of focus.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT
history.text: ESO 於 1980 年代後期決定建造由四座 8 m 級望遠鏡組成的 VLT，並選定智利 Cerro Paranal 為站址；第一座 UT 於 1998 年取得初光，其餘三座在之後數年陸續完成，VLTI 也在 2000 年代初取得首批條紋。2016 年 UT4 的自適應光學設施以 1170 致動器可變形副鏡與四雷射導引星取得初光，使 VLT 從被動大口徑轉向以自適應光學與干涉為核心的平台。
history.textEn: ESO decided in the late 1980s to build the VLT as four 8 m class telescopes and chose Cerro Paranal in Chile as the site; the first UT saw first light in 1998, the other three followed over the next few years, and VLTI obtained its first fringes in the early 2000s. In 2016 the UT4 Adaptive Optics Facility reached first light with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and four laser guide stars, turning the VLT from a passive large-aperture facility into a platform built around adaptive optics and interferometry.

history.text: 本課把「集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界」到「多望遠鏡營運：主鏡重鍍、通量與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary" through "Multi-telescope operation: recoating, throughput and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
